meta.title: Marisship · Free tools for buying from China through shopping agents
meta.description: Shipping calculator, link converter and haul planner for Taobao, Tmall, Weidian and 1688. Free, open source, no affiliate links, no tracking.
meta.ogTagline: Free tools for buying from China. No affiliate links, no tracking.

footer.tagline: A free compass for shopping in China.
footer.disclaimer: Marisship is an independent project. It is not affiliated with Taobao, Tmall, Weidian, 1688 or any shopping agent: their names are used only to describe compatibility, and trademarks belong to their owners. Marisship contains no affiliate links, ads or tracking, and does not support buying counterfeit goods.
footer.estimates: Every figure is an estimate: always confirm the final price with your agent.

home.eyebrow: Free tools · No account · No affiliate links
home.title: Set sail for Taobao, Weidian and 1688 without surprises.
home.intro: Estimate shipping, convert links between agents and plan your haul before you pay. Marisship is free, open source and earns nothing from your choices.
home.toolsIntro: Five tools that run in your browser, in English and Italian.

tools.calculator: Actual and volumetric weight, fees and discounts in one honest total.
tools.converter: Turn a marketplace or agent link into clean links for every supported agent.
tools.hold: Collect items, add up price and weight, and see what your parcel will weigh.
tools.search: Jump to the official search on Taobao, Tmall and 1688, with a Chinese keyword cheat sheet.
tools.agents: A neutral list of agents and what Marisship can do with their links.

home.stepsTitle: From link to doorstep in three moves

steps.title: Find
steps.text: Pick an item on Taobao, Tmall, Weidian or 1688, or start a search from Marisship.

steps.title: Convert
steps.text: Paste the link to get a clean link for your agent, or stow the item in the Hold.

steps.title: Weigh anchor
steps.text: Estimate shipping with your agent's real rates, then order with no surprises.

promises.title: No affiliate links
promises.text: Every agent link is plain. Nobody pays to be listed first.

promises.title: No tracking
promises.text: No cookies, no analytics. Your Hold stays in your browser.

promises.title: No made-up prices
promises.text: Rates come from you, or from verified and dated tables.

promises.title: Open source
promises.text: The code is public under GPL-3.0: read it, fork it, improve it.

home.counterfeitText: Marisship is built for legitimate purchases. Counterfeit goods can be seized by EU customs, and in Italy buyers can also be fined.

calculator.title: Shipping calculator
calculator.metaDescription: Estimate the real cost of an international parcel from China: volumetric weight, fuel surcharge, fees and discounts, with your agent's own rates.
calculator.intro: Enter the rate your agent quotes for a shipping line. Marisship works out the chargeable weight and every fee, so you see the real total before you pay.
calculator.divisorHelp: Most lines use 6000 (cm³ per kg); some use 5000 or 8000. Check your line's terms.
calculator.rateHelp: Copy the numbers from your agent's shipping estimate, in yuan (CNY).
calculator.vipHelp: VIP level or coupon, applied to shipping only.
calculator.fxSource: ECB reference rate of {date} (via Frankfurter). Change it if your agent uses another rate.
calculator.fxManual: Live rate unavailable: enter the rate your agent shows.
calculator.volumetricWins: Volume beats weight here: you pay for space, not kilos.
calculator.invalid: Enter a weight and a rate to see the estimate.
calculator.compareIntro: This table only uses rates that someone has verified, with date and source.
calculator.compareEmpty: No verified rates yet. Rates change often and we don't publish guesses: if you have verified ones, you can add them on GitHub.

converter.title: Link converter
converter.metaDescription: Convert Taobao, Tmall, Weidian and 1688 links between shopping agents. Clean links, no tracking parameters, no affiliate codes.
converter.intro: Paste links from Taobao, Tmall, Weidian, 1688 or a shopping agent, one per line. You get the clean marketplace link and the matching link for every supported agent.
converter.unsupported: Not recognised. Paste an item link from a marketplace or from a supported agent.
converter.resolveFailed: This short link could not be expanded. Open it in your browser and paste the full link.
converter.help: Shared Taobao texts work too: Marisship finds the link inside. Links from many other agents that carry the original link are recognised as well.
converter.privacy: Conversion happens in your browser. Short links are expanded by our server, which only follows official marketplace short-link domains and does not store links.

hold.title: The Hold
hold.metaDescription: Plan your haul from China: list items, add up prices and estimated weight, and send the total weight to the shipping calculator.
hold.intro: Your haul planner. Add the items you want with price and estimated weight: Marisship adds everything up and sends the weight to the shipping calculator. Everything stays in this browser.
hold.name: Name or note
hold.empty: The Hold is empty. Add your first item here, or send one from the link converter.
hold.confirmClear: Remove every item from the Hold?
hold.importError: This file is not a valid Marisship Hold export.
hold.storageWarning: Your browser blocks local storage: the Hold works, but it will empty when you leave the page.
hold.tip: Weights are estimates: agents weigh items when they reach the warehouse, and packaging adds weight too.
hold.unrecognised: Link not recognised: saved as is.

search.title: Marketplace search
search.metaDescription: Search Taobao, Tmall and 1688 from one place, with a cheat sheet of useful Chinese keywords.
search.intro: Type what you're looking for and Marisship opens the marketplace's official search in a new tab. Chinese keywords usually give far better results.
search.note1688: 1688 asks you to sign in before showing results.
search.noteWeidian: Weidian has no public web search: look for the shop, or paste item links into the converter.
search.glossaryIntro: Tap a term to put it in the search box, then combine it with others (e.g. 帆布包 大容量).

agents.title: Shopping agents
agents.metaDescription: A neutral list of shopping agents for Taobao, Weidian and 1688, with the link formats supported by the Marisship converter.
agents.intro: A shopping agent buys on Chinese marketplaces for you, checks the goods at its warehouse and ships them abroad. This list is neutral: we don't rank agents and we earn nothing from them.
agents.howText: An agent joins the converter only after we verify its link format on its own website. The date shows the latest check. Being listed is not a recommendation: read recent reviews, compare fees and check shipping lines before you choose.
agents.chooseText: There is no universal best agent: it depends on your country, the shipping lines available and the fees.
agents.guideLink: Read: how a shopping agent works

guides.title: Guides
guides.metaDescription: Plain-language guides for buying from China through shopping agents: costs, weight, shipping lines.
guides.intro: Practical guides for buying from China, written in plain language. No sponsors.

contact.title: Contact
contact.metaDescription: How to report a problem or suggest an improvement to Marisship.
contact.intro: Marisship has no customer service or mailbox: we talk in the open, on GitHub.
contact.issuesText: Report a bug, a broken link format, an outdated rate or an idea. You need a free GitHub account.
contact.warning: Issues are public: don't write personal data, order numbers or addresses.
contact.codeText: Marisship is free software under the GPL-3.0 licence.

legal.privacyDescription: What data Marisship processes: none of yours, apart from the technical logs of the hosting provider.
legal.termsDescription: The rules for using Marisship: free tools, estimates only, no affiliation.
